title: Recipe 06: Upload and asynchronous work
summary: Real file bytes create a server-side job with progress, cancellation, failure, and retry. The model sees job metadata, not the file.
summaryZh: 真实文件字节创建服务端任务，包含进度、取消、失败与重试。模型看到任务元数据，而不是文件内容。

files.label: App.vue
files.role: Upload UI, polling, and job actions
files.roleZh: 上传界面、轮询与任务动作

guide.title: Separate starting work from finishing it
guide.titleZh: 把启动任务与完成任务分开
intro: The upload request returns a job, not a completed document. The page polls and reports a bounded state view.
A filename containing “virus” deliberately fails so retry and cancellation can be inspected.
introZh: 上传请求返回任务，而不是已完成的文档。页面轮询并报告有界状态。
文件名包含 “virus” 会刻意失败，便于观察重试与取消。

steps.title: Send bytes to the application
steps.body: The browser posts the file to the local service. The assistant is not given the file content.
steps.bodyZh: 浏览器把文件发送给本地服务。助手不会拿到文件内容。

steps.title: Expose job state
steps.body: Only ids, states, and progress enter the state view.
steps.bodyZh: 只有 id、状态与进度进入状态视图。

steps.title: Make cancel and retry explicit
steps.body: Each row declares only the action valid for its current state.
steps.bodyZh: 每一行只声明当前状态有效的动作。

guide.note: Upload any small file, then upload a filename containing “virus”. Cancel one active job and retry the failed one.
guide.noteZh: 上传任意小文件，再上传一个名称含 “virus” 的文件。取消一个进行中任务，并重试失败任务。
